maddeler.e:
استظرفوا (form X)
# اِسْتَظْرَفُوا (istaẓrafū) /is.taðˤ.ra.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَظْرَفَ (istaẓrafa)
# اُسْتُظْرِفُوا (ustuẓrifū) /us.tuðˤ.ri.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَظْرَفَ (istaẓrafa)
# اِسْتَظْرِفُوا (istaẓrifū) /is.taðˤ.ri.fuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَظْرَفَ (istaẓrafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
